  "Surgical excision is the first-line management for melanoma.",
  "When melanoma is suspected, the entire lesion should be completely excised.",
  "The excision margin should be narrow, between 1 and 3 millimeters, to allow histological diagnosis.",
  "For primary cutaneous melanoma of any thickness, surgical excision with histologically negative margins is recommended.",
  "For melanoma in situ, surgical excision with histologically negative margins is recommended.",
  "The surgical excision margin should be determined based on tumor thickness.",
  "If a sentinel lymph node biopsy is indicated, it should be performed before wide excision.",
  "Sentinel lymph node biopsy should preferably be performed in the same operative setting as wide excision."
